cad.title: pcb-enclosure
cad.subtitle: custom-fit enclosure for pcb assembly
cad.description: I was tasked with designing a custom PCB enclosure. The design was simple, cost-effective, and easy to print
cad.problem: I struggled with optimising weight to ensure an efficient product was designed
cad.solution: I chose to proceed with lighter plastic PVC given its poor electrical conductivity to prevent short-circuit of electrical components

cad.title: Helical Gear
cad.subtitle: Helical gear model
cad.description: I was tasked with designing a helical gear. The aim of this project was to demonstrate my skills in chamfering, cut-extrude operations, and my understanding of gear mechanics.
cad.problem: Determining the appropriate gear ratio relative to the gear size was challenging. A higher tooth-to-size ratio resulted in distorted or damaged gear geometry.
cad.solution: I experimented with reducing the number of teeth until the gear geometry was properly formed while maintaining the desired design characteristics.

cad.title: Sheet Metal Electronic Enclosure
cad.subtitle: Designed a custom sheet metal enclosure using SolidWorks Sheet Metal tools.
cad.description: This project involved designing a custom electronic enclosure from sheet metal using SolidWorks. The objective was to gain practical experience with sheet metal features such as Base Flange, Edge Flange, Hem, Bend Relief, Corner Treatment, and Flat Pattern generation while ensuring the enclosure was suitable for manufacturing and assembly.
cad.problem: The challenge was to create an enclosure that could securely house electronic components while maintaining proper bend allowances, manufacturability, and an accurate flat pattern for fabrication. Another challenge was ensuring all bends and corners could be produced without interference or material failure during forming.
cad.solution: The enclosure was modeled using SolidWorks Sheet Metal tools, beginning with a base flange and progressively adding edge flanges and bends to form the enclosure. Manufacturing considerations such as bend radii, relief cuts, and corner treatments were incorporated throughout the design. A flat pattern was then generated to verify that the enclosure could be fabricated from a single sheet of metal with minimal waste and accurate bend geometry.

cad.title: Valve Body
cad.subtitle: valve-body
cad.description: This project involves recreating a valve body from a detailed engineering drawing using SolidWorks. The model features flanged connections, intersecting flow passages, bolt-hole patterns, fillets, and complex curved geometry. The objective is to strengthen engineering drawing interpretation, feature-based modeling, and the design of manufacturable mechanical components.
cad.problem: While modeling the valve body, I encountered a sketch plane issue that prevented the cut-extrude and hole features from intersecting the model correctly. Troubleshooting and correcting the sketch plane required additional time, preventing completion of the model within the allocated session. The project remains a work in progress.
cad.solution: The sketch plane issue was identified as the root cause of the failed cut operations. The model will be updated by reassigning the sketches to the correct faces, verifying feature directions, and completing the remaining hole patterns and finishing features
